scenes.headline: They just keep coming
scenes.voiceover: Wave after wave, they march toward your base. Your only job? Stop them. Welcome to tower defense.

scenes.headline: Build. Wait. Defend.
scenes.sub: Place towers along the enemy's path
scenes.voiceover: The loop is simple. Spend coins on towers, place them along the path, and watch them fire as each wave walks past.

scenes.headline: Rampart sets the stage
scenes.sub: An Atari arcade game often called the genre's ancestor
scenes.voiceover: The roots go back to 1990, when Atari's arcade game Rampart had players build walls and cannons to fend off attacking ships.

scenes.headline: Flash games made it a craze
scenes.sub: Desktop Tower Defense let you build the maze yourself
scenes.voiceover: In 2007, the browser game Desktop Tower Defense let players build the maze themselves, and suddenly everyone was playing.

scenes.headline: Plants vs. Zombies goes mainstream
scenes.sub: Sunflowers, peashooters and a lawn to protect
scenes.voiceover: Then in 2009, Plants versus Zombies put the genre on every phone and laptop, one peashooter at a time.

scenes.headline: Hold the line
scenes.purpose: Payoff with the tower standing strong.
scenes.voiceover: Smart placement beats brute force. Pick your towers wisely, and hold the line.
